npmatch: nonprofit record linkage to the IRS BMF

Source: R/npmatch-package.R
npmatch-package.Rd

A geography-adaptive, tiered linkage pipeline built as a thin layer over reclin2. The stages compose left to right:

Details

  1. np_query() / np_reference() — map a dataset onto canonical fields

  2. np_normalize() — standardize names/addresses, extract veto features

  3. np_compare() — block and score candidate pairs (reclin2)

  4. np_score() — combine field similarities (weighted / EM / model)

  5. np_veto() — apply hard do-not-match rules

  6. np_select() — best entity per query, plus loosened name/addr views

  7. np_tier() — sort into YES / MAYBE / NO

np_match() runs the whole chain; np_label_frame() emits training data.
